# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(hdf5r)
library(harmony)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(scDblFinder)
```



# Read in data

## CD45- populations

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_CTL <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Pryce_scKPP/GSM7920260_S61_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
KPP_CD45neg_KPP <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Pryce_scKPP/GSM7920261_S62_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
```


## CD45+ populations

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45pos_CTL <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Pryce_scKPP/GSM7920262_S63_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
KPP_CD45pos_KPP <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Pryce_scKPP/GSM7920263_S64_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
```



# Create Seurat object

## CD45- populations

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_CTL_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = KPP_CD45neg_CTL, min.cells = 3, project = "Pryce_scKPP_CTL")
KPP_CD45neg_KPP_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = KPP_CD45neg_KPP, min.cells = 3, project = "Pryce_scKPP_KPP")
```


## CD45+ populations

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45pos_CTL_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = KPP_CD45pos_CTL, min.cells = 3, project = "Pryce_scKPP_CTL")
KPP_CD45pos_KPP_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = KPP_CD45pos_KPP, min.cells = 3, project = "Pryce_scKPP_KPP")
```



# 1. QC

## % mitochondrial reads

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_CTL_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_so, pattern = "^mt-")

KPP_CD45neg_KPP_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(KPP_CD45neg_KPP_so, pattern = "^mt-")

KPP_CD45pos_CTL_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(KPP_CD45pos_CTL_so, pattern = "^mt-")

KPP_CD45pos_KPP_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(KPP_CD45pos_KPP_so, pattern = "^mt-")
```



# 2. Filtering

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_CTL_filtered <- subset(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_so, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)

KPP_CD45neg_KPP_filtered <- subset(KPP_CD45neg_KPP_so, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)

KPP_CD45pos_CTL_filtered <- subset(KPP_CD45pos_CTL_so, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)

KPP_CD45pos_KPP_filtered <- subset(KPP_CD45pos_KPP_so, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
```



# 3. Pre-process

```{r, include=FALSE}
all_genes_KPP_CD45neg_CTL <- rownames(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_filtered)

all_genes_KPP_CD45neg_KPP <- rownames(KPP_CD45neg_KPP_filtered)

all_genes_KPP_CD45pos_CTL <- rownames(KPP_CD45pos_CTL_filtered)

all_genes_KPP_CD45pos_KPP <- rownames(KPP_CD45pos_KPP_filtered)
```


## KPP_CD45neg_CTL

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm <- KPP_CD45neg_CTL_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_KPP_CD45neg_CTL) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm <- KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:39) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:39)
```


## KPP_CD45neg_KPP

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm <- KPP_CD45neg_KPP_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_KPP_CD45neg_KPP) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm <- KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:39) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:39)
```


## KPP_CD45pos_CTL

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm <- KPP_CD45pos_CTL_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_KPP_CD45pos_CTL) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm <- KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:32) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:32)
```


## KPP_CD45pos_KPP

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm <- KPP_CD45pos_KPP_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_KPP_CD45pos_KPP) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm <- KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:41) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:41)
```



# 4. scDblFinder

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_CTL_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm))

KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm$scDblFinder.class <- KPP_CD45neg_CTL_dbl$scDblFinder.class


KPP_CD45neg_KPP_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm))

KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm$scDblFinder.class <- KPP_CD45neg_KPP_dbl$scDblFinder.class


KPP_CD45pos_CTL_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm))

KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm$scDblFinder.class <- KPP_CD45pos_CTL_dbl$scDblFinder.class


KPP_CD45pos_KPP_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm))

KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm$scDblFinder.class <- KPP_CD45pos_KPP_dbl$scDblFinder.class
```


## See number of singlets vs. doublets

```{r}
table(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm$scDblFinder.class)
table(KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm$scDblFinder.class)
table(KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm$scDblFinder.class)
table(KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm$scDblFinder.class)
```


## Remove doublets

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_CD45neg_CTL_singlets <- subset(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

KPP_CD45pos_CTL_singlets <- subset(KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

KPP_CD45neg_KPP_singlets <- subset(KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

KPP_CD45pos_KPP_singlets <- subset(KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")
```



# 5. Combine conditions

## Remove unused objects from environment to allow processing

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(KPP_CD45neg_CTL, KPP_CD45neg_CTL_so, KPP_CD45neg_CTL_filtered, KPP_CD45neg_CTL_norm, KPP_CD45neg_CTL_dbl, KPP_CD45neg_KPP, KPP_CD45neg_KPP_so, KPP_CD45neg_KPP_filtered, KPP_CD45neg_KPP_norm, KPP_CD45neg_KPP_dbl, KPP_CD45pos_CTL, KPP_CD45pos_CTL_so, KPP_CD45pos_CTL_filtered, KPP_CD45pos_CTL_norm, KPP_CD45pos_CTL_dbl, KPP_CD45pos_KPP, KPP_CD45pos_KPP_so, KPP_CD45pos_KPP_filtered, KPP_CD45pos_KPP_norm, KPP_CD45pos_KPP_dbl)
```


## Merge data

```{r, include=FALSE}
ordered_datasets_KPP <- c(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_singlets,
                          KPP_CD45neg_KPP_singlets,
                          KPP_CD45pos_CTL_singlets,
                          KPP_CD45pos_KPP_singlets)
features_merge_KPP <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ordered_datasets_KPP)
```


## Find anchors

```{r, include=FALSE}
anchors_merge_KPP <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = list(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_singlets, KPP_CD45neg_KPP_singlets, KPP_CD45pos_CTL_singlets, KPP_CD45pos_KPP_singlets), anchor.features = features_merge_KPP)
```


## Remove unused objects from environment

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(KPP_CD45neg_CTL_singlets, KPP_CD45neg_KPP_singlets, KPP_CD45pos_CTL_singlets, KPP_CD45pos_KPP_singlets)
```


## Combine data

```{r, include=FALSE}
Pryce_scKPP <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors_merge_KPP)
DefaultAssay(Pryce_scKPP) <- "integrated"
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(anchors_merge_KPP, ordered_datasets_KPP, all_genes_KPP_CD45neg_CTL, all_genes_KPP_CD45neg_KPP, all_genes_KPP_CD45pos_CTL, all_genes_KPP_CD45pos_KPP, features_merge_KPP)
```
